I'm currently a **Research Professional at the [IMAGINA Research Center](https://imagina.uniandes.edu.co/), Universidad de los Andes**, where I contribute data and content to public indicator dashboards as part of collaborative teams, co-lead experimental research, and own analytical pipelines from raw data to estimation.

Beyond the data work, I care about **evidence-to-policy**: I work with government counterparts, civil society, and research teams so that results are **documented, reproducible, and usable** for decisions. I also teach as a Teaching Assistant in Economic Analysis of Public Policy at the M.A. level.

## Experience (Brief Overview)

- **Research Professional**\
  *IMAGINA Research Center, Universidad de los Andes \| Jun 2023 – Present*\
  Focus on **creating, feeding, and documenting indicators** for public dashboards, a **pre-registered RCT** on violence detection and social norms, and **SEM and mediation models** on childhood adversity.

- **Policy Data Analyst and Consultant**\
  *Secretaría de Integración Social, Bogotá District Government \| Jun 2025 – Feb 2026*\
  Led a team evaluating **51 district social policies**, applying **large language models** in automated Python pipelines and facilitating workshops across 20 localities.

- **Research Analyst**\
  *Vice-Presidency of Research & Creation, Universidad de los Andes \| Mar 2022 – May 2023*\
  Worked on **Theory of Change and cost-effectiveness analysis** for social programs and harmonized **VACS microdata across 17 countries** (CDC- and USAID-sponsored).

- **Research Assistant Intern**\
  *Alberto Lleras Camargo School of Government, Universidad de los Andes \| Aug 2021 – Feb 2022*\
  Synthesized evidence and analyzed data on **teenage pregnancy, child protection, and violence** against children and women.
